usageNotes: Creates a named SDN prefix list that can be referenced by BGP route-map filters or firewall rules to match sets of IP prefixes. Requires the SDN.Allocate privilege on /sdn/prefix-lists. Changes to SDN configuration are staged until applied with the SDN apply operation; the prefix list is not active in the data plane until that apply is run.

examples.summary: Create a prefix list for RFC 1918 private address space

tips: The id must conform to the pve-sdn-prefix-list-id format — use lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens only.
Supply the current config digest to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.
After creating the prefix list, run the SDN apply operation (POST /cluster/sdn) to push the change to all nodes.
The lock-token param is only needed when you hold an explicit SDN config lock; omit it for normal single-operation writes.
